ownership_rule: each assertion_id has exactly one primary_swu; shared witnesses are regression or recomposition checks only

assertions.positive_assertion: whole and region digests recompute from their exact canonical objects, including literal null staged identity
assertions.negative_mutant: changed object with retained hash and changed whole with retained region hash are rejected

assertions.selector_or_test_name: store token retries torn projection reads
assertions.positive_assertion: equal before and after store-owned tokens admit one snapshot
assertions.negative_mutant: three consecutive mismatched token pairs produce ProjectionSnapshotUnstableError after one initial attempt plus exactly two retries and emit no snapshot

assertions.positive_assertion: /state version and compatibility fields derive from one accepted snapshot and current hard-coded route constructors
assertions.negative_mutant: compatibility head from a later read fails equality with the projection snapshot

assertions.positive_assertion: two poll intervals cause zero main-document navigation, region patch, focus movement, scroll change, and announcement
assertions.negative_mutant: whole-document reload on unchanged version increments the navigation counter

assertions.selector_or_test_name: UPW-005 action queues one trailing refresh
assertions.positive_assertion: an action completing during an older poll obtains one trailing fetch and applies the unseen version once
assertions.negative_mutant: duplicate response and missing trailing-slot mutants respectively double-patch or remain stale

assertions.positive_assertion: valid target, drafts, focus, scroll, and expansion bindings produce preserve operations without mutating live DOM
assertions.negative_mutant: changed head, target, candidate, revision, frame source, or region identity produces only the matching typed invalidation and reason

assertions.selector_or_test_name: UPW-007 renderer failure rolls back regions and context
assertions.positive_assertion: prepared regions and the typed context plan commit together before applied versions advance
assertions.negative_mutant: renderer N failure restores every mount, context value, and prior whole and region version

assertions.positive_assertion: [data-region=spine] exposes exact [data-testid=lifecycle-state], current identity, progress, connection state, and [data-testid=next-action] for every lifecycle state
assertions.negative_mutant: RevisionApplied shown as current or next action shown without its prerequisite identity fails the state matrix

assertions.positive_assertion: [data-region=canvas] iframe[data-current-head] carries the current-head accessible name and keeps its source stable while current-head identity is unchanged
assertions.negative_mutant: binding the canvas to the first historical variant or navigating it on an unrelated region change fails identity and navigation counters

assertions.positive_assertion: [data-region=inspector] renders only the state-valid annotation, comment, batch, staged, or revision context and exposes disabled reasons
assertions.negative_mutant: staged controls in BaselineReady or an annotation form without current-head identity fail region admission

assertions.positive_assertion: [data-region=review] presents candidate identity, diff recap, and distinct Before current and After candidate frame names
assertions.negative_mutant: swapped frame routes, identical frame names, or missing candidate identity fails the staged-review assertion

assertions.positive_assertion: [data-region=actions] routes Accept, Discard, and Revert through existing handlers with exact live identity and acknowledgment gates
assertions.negative_mutant: missing or stale acknowledgment, browser Export, or feedback written to the wrong state scope is rejected

assertions.positive_assertion: [data-region=history] is labelled non-current, collapsed after a current head exists, follows active work in DOM order, and preserves expansion across unrelated updates
assertions.negative_mutant: expanded-by-default history before active work or expansion reset after unchanged identity fails the history contract

assertions.positive_assertion: at 390x844 spine, canvas, inspector or review, actions, then collapsed history appear without document horizontal overflow or covered content
assertions.negative_mutant: desktop chronology forced onto mobile or any scrollWidth greater than clientWidth fails

assertions.selector_or_test_name: UPW-015 state and action copy matrix
assertions.positive_assertion: current head, staged candidate, recorded revision, historical, browser actions, and secondary CLI details match the literal state matrix
assertions.negative_mutant: unqualified approved, ready, safe, complete, or browser Export wording fails

assertions.selector_or_test_name: UPW-016 keyboard focus and scoped status
assertions.positive_assertion: keyboard and pointer use the same handlers; focus persists or moves to the new task heading; only #cf-msg, #act-msg, and #act-msg2 are polite atomic status scopes; the tested blocking error alone is assertive
assertions.negative_mutant: pointer-only activation, lost focus, unrelated live region, or recoverable error promoted to assertive fails

assertions.positive_assertion: sampled light-surface normal text is at least 4.5:1, outer actions meet 24x24 CSS pixels or record the allowed exception, visible focus is perceivable, and text or state survives removal of color cues
assertions.negative_mutant: low contrast, undersized target without exception, invisible focus, or color-only state fails calibrated checks

assertions.positive_assertion: only exact /raw/current, /annotate/current, /raw/staged, and domain-valid /raw/variant/{label} families are admitted before versioning
assertions.negative_mutant: external, protocol-relative, encoded traversal, query-smuggled, and unknown family routes return ProjectionRouteRejectedError and no projection

assertions.positive_assertion: raw frames have an empty sandbox token set, annotation alone has exact allow-scripts, and outer server data is rendered through textContent, explicit nodes, and allowlisted attributes
assertions.negative_mutant: removed or expanded sandbox token and raw outer-shell HTML sink each fail before admission
